references.text: The instructions for dismembering the burnt offering and burning the parts on the altar, which Moses is now carrying out in practice with the ram.
A parallel description of dismembering the sacrificial animal into pieces and placing the head and fat on the altar for the burnt offering.
The immediate context where the ram for the burnt offering is brought forward and slaughtered before being dismembered.
The continuation of the burnt offering rituals where the entrails and legs are washed and burned on the altar.
The original instruction given to Moses to dismember the ram and burn it on the altar during the priestly consecration.
Aaron performs the same procedure with the burnt offering after his consecration, with the head and pieces burned on the altar.
